deployments_detail.use: GenAI virtual assistant + agent-assist across customer service (partnered Google Cloud + Accenture, 2024)

Gen AI-powered virtual assistant for customer self-service on BestBuy.com, the mobile app, and the support phone line: troubleshoots product issues, reschedules/combines deliveries, and manages subscriptions/software [Google Cloud (Gemini models, Vertex AI); Accenture]

Agent-assist AI for contact-center care agents: real-time conversation summarization, sentiment detection, and in-the-moment recommendations to reduce agent cognitive load [Google Cloud (Contact Center AI / Gemini); Accenture]
Gen AI assistant for in-store / front-line employees giving quick access to internal company resources and product guides [Google Cloud; Accenture]
Named as a Google Gemini / Vertex AI customer/case study [Google Gemini / Vertex AI] [Google Gemini / Vertex AI]
AI in the supply chain: predictive demand forecasting, data scaling and digital twins to shift from reactive to preventive inventory positioning and logistics [none named]
Consolidation of the contact-center technology stack (starting from 93 separate applications) into a unified AI-powered platform for agents [Google Cloud; Accenture]

AI-powered search experience across web and app that uses AI prompts and conversational filtering to guide shoppers to fewer, higher-quality results reflecting customer intent (also for employees) [none named]

AI/ML-driven personalization in the Best Buy mobile app: personalized home screen and 'Discover' tab recommendations across hundreds of categories based on shopping history, membership, and preferences [none named]
Integration of Best Buy's product catalog into OpenAI's ChatGPT to enable AI-driven product discovery within the chatbot (agentic commerce) [OpenAI (ChatGPT)]

Agentic commerce with Google: enabling customers to make purchases from Best Buy directly in Google Search AI Mode and the Gemini app, and making bestbuy.com more agent-friendly (Universal Commerce Protocol) [Google (AI Mode, Gemini, Universal Commerce Protocol)]

Best Buy Ads retail media network: AI and data science power audience segmentation, predictive targeting, and creative content production at scale (3,000 campaigns/year, aiming to double) [Adobe (service support); The Trade Desk, Google DV360, Yahoo DSP (DSP integrations)]
deployments_detail.value: ~93% of transactional revenue attributed to customer IDs; 3,000 campaigns/year
